Designed as a simple plug and play solution, this upgrade adds extra comfort while turning your seat into an adjustable setup for riders of different heights. Whether you are cruising, drifting, or riding for longer sessions, the added cushion and adjustability make the cart feel more comfortable and easier to dial in.

Install is simple with our step by step guide, giving your setup a cleaner, more comfortable ride without overcomplicating the process.

tottoms-7070-motor-mount-for-oem-stock-f.title: Adjustable 7070 Motor Mount for OEM Stock Fork
tottoms-7070-motor-mount-for-oem-stock-f.tags: Crazy Cart XL, Standard Crazy Cart
tottoms-7070-motor-mount-for-oem-stock-f.descriptionHtml:
Meet the easiest 7070 motor mount tension adjustment system on the market.

Simply loosen both lock nuts, rotate the motor up or down to dial in your chain or belt tension, then tighten everything back down.

Built from heavy-duty 1/4 inch steel, this mount uses our single-pin adjustment system to make tensioning fast, precise, and hassle-free.

The single pivot-point design removes the need for the stock chain tensioner when used with the stock fork, creating a more direct torque feel and a cleaner, more connected driving experience.

tottoms-blackout-pro-kart.title: "Blackout" Belt Drive PRO Kart
tottoms-blackout-pro-kart.descriptionHtml:
2026 TOTTOMS™ PRO KART

Top Speed 45mph (with 60v)

The new 2026 Edition

Designed for both teens and adults up to 6'4 with the adjustable seat upgrade. 

Built for the spots you've been eyeing. Empty parking lots, smooth streets, late night sessions with your crew. This kart is designed for durability, smoothness, speed, and extended battery life.

Why does it cost $2,699?

You're not paying for a DIY build. You're paying for years of development that went into building something that actually rips.

You're paying for a full brushless powertrain with the ability to tune the kart through a simple phone app. You're paying for the Tottoms PRO fork system, which gives you access to our hydraulic brake kit and a PRO fork lifetime warranty. You're getting a sealed headset compared to the stock open bearing setup, giving you smooth and precise steering every time.

You're paying for the Tottoms caster upgrade, built with sealed bearings that keep the grime out and support the wider longboard wheels designed for high speed and durability. You're paying for our high quality lithium batteries that don't sag under high load and deliver instant torque. 

And most of all, you're getting something that took years of testing and real world development to get right. One of the most reliable and easy to maintain setups on the market today.

How fast does it go?

That depends on the voltage you pick at checkout. Same kart, same motor, different battery.

36V — 1,080W — ~25 mph — Learning, technical spots

48V — 2,880W — ~35 mph — Most popular, great all-rounder

60V — 4,000W — ~45 mph — Maximum performance and torque

Not sure which to pick? Start with 48V. It's our most popular setup, fast enough to be genuinely exciting, controlled enough to learn on, and you can always upgrade to 60V later with a battery swap. No new motor required.

How far can it go?

36V — 10 to 15 miles range — 6 to 8 hour charge time

48V — 20+ miles range — 3 to 4 hour charge time

60V — 20+ miles range — 2 to 3 hour charge time

All on a single charge. Enough to go out, explore, and come back without thinking about the battery.

What makes Tottoms PRO Karts different.

We were the first company to build fully brushless pre-built crazy carts. Brushless means more power, more efficiency, less heat, longer life and less maintenance. Other companies may still be running brushed setups or don't have nearly the experience that we do.

We also run belt drive instead of chain. Smoother, quieter, and it doesn't stretch over time the way a chain does. Less maintenance and better power delivery on every session.

What's included.

Every PRO Kart ships fully assembled and pre-tested. You ride it, you don't build it.

PRO Kart

1x Tottoms PRO Kart

1x PRO Fork with Hydraulic Brakes

1x Belt Drive System

1x Brushless Powertrain

1x Lithium Battery

1x Caster Upgrade

1x Lithium 5A Battery Charger

Display (if opted)

1x Pre-Installed Display

1x Display to VESC Adapter

2x Mounting Hardware

Adjustable Seat (if opted)

1x Adjustable Cushioned Seat

1x Pre-Installed Seat Adapter Plate

Underglow Kit (if opted)

1x Pre-Installed Underglow

1x 12V Battery Pack

1x 12V Battery Charger

Optional add-ons at checkout.

3.5" Display: real-time speed, battery percentage, motor and controller temps, and an on-the-fly speed and power selector. 

Adjustable cushioned seat, fits riders up to 6'4".

LED underglow kit, pre-installed.

Hand assembled in Florida.

Every kart is built and tested by hand before it ships. 

Weight limit: 225 to 250 lbs. Kart weight: approximately 75 to 85 lbs depending on spec.
